crm_import_jobs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE crm_import_jobs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	organization_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_import_id INTEGER, 
	inbound_import_id INTEGER, 
	input_object_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	parameters JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR, 
	lease_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	available_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error VARCHAR(200), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_crm_import_job_target CHECK ((owner_import_id IS NOT NULL) <> (inbound_import_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_crm_import_job_status CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'retry_wait', 'completed', 'failed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_crm_import_job_attempts CHECK (attempt_count >= 0 AND max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10), 
	UNIQUE (owner_import_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_import_id) REFERENCES crm_contact_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (inbound_import_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_import_id) REFERENCES crm_inbound_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (input_object_key)
)

whatsapp_connections.ddl:
CREATE TABLE whatsapp_connections (

	organization_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phone_number_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	market_data_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

whatsapp_contacts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE whatsapp_contacts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	connection_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	wa_id VARCHAR, 
	bsuid VARCHAR, 
	name VARCHAR, 
	in_address_book BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	blocked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	blocked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_whatsapp_contact_wa_id UNIQUE (connection_id, wa_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_whatsapp_contact_bsuid UNIQUE (connection_id, bsuid), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connection_id) REFERENCES whatsapp_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

whatsapp_customer_messages.ddl:
CREATE TABLE whatsapp_customer_messages (
	id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT, 
	sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reply TEXT, 
	risk VARCHAR, 
	topic VARCHAR, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	evidence_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	evidence_snapshots JSON NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	send_after TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	notification_created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	notification_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

	error_code VARCHAR, 
	handoff_summary TEXT, 
	asked_detail VARCHAR,

whatsapp_customer_threads.ddl:
CREATE TABLE whatsapp_customer_threads (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	connection_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	paused BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	opted_out BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_whatsapp_customer_thread_sender UNIQUE (connection_id, sender), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connection_id) REFERENCES whatsapp_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
